title: H 4513 (126th General Assembly): Election Transparency and Accountability Act

(section) Sec. 1 (new 7-5-35(6))
(quote) proof of citizenship, any actions taken to verify citizenship, and any actions taken to remove noncitizens from the voter registration list.
(other) Sec. 1 (new 7-5-35): county boards must keep and give qualified electors, free, cast vote records, poll lists, logic and accuracy testing reports, ballot reconciliation reports, chain-of-custody documents, and citizenship records.
(other) Sec. 2 (new 7-13-870): right of any citizen to observe election processes, staying five feet from voters.
(other) Sec. 3 (new 7-13-880): chain-of-custody records for election equipment, kept 24 months.
(other) Sec. 4 (new 7-13-1180): hand-count audit of at least ten percent of precincts after each statewide primary and general election.
(other) Sec. 5 (new 7-13-1455): forensic audit and full hand recount if audit and tabulated totals differ by 0.002 percent or more.
(other) Sec. 6: effective on approval by the Governor.
(other) version: Only one version (Introduced, 2025-05-06). No ID or citizenship-proof rule; slot e item is a records-access duty about citizenship records. All text is new sections, so there are no strike/new marks.
(other) note: Not an ID or citizenship-proof bill. The only citizenship words are in the records list quoted in slot e. Only the introduced text is saved.
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
